_comment: Hyperparameters of the parametric modal operator network (src/py/model/PF/pfParamFit.py, CFG); applied to every run of the paper, a run may override single values with its 'cfg' entry

_help.K: number of space functions (trunk outputs) and time constants
_help.width, depth: neurons per layer and hidden layers of the trunk (rate net: 2 x 64)
_help.nF: Fourier frequencies per input coordinate of the trunk
_help.rel: coordinates relative to the chips as trunk inputs
_help.alpha, beta, gamma: weights of the data, physics (FV residual) and steady-state losses
_help.lr, nStep, epoch, pat: learning rate, steps per epoch, maximum epochs, early-stopping patience (epochs)
_help.nbD, nD: labelled boards per step and sampled nodes per board (data loss)
_help.nbP, nR: physics-only boards per step and sampled residual nodes per board
_help.nbS: boards per step of the steady-state loss
_help.tP, holds: length (s) and hold times (s) of the random profiles of the physics loss
_help.nCache, nNew: dense G^-1 cache of the physics loss (boards) and boards replaced per epoch
_help.tauCap: upper limit of the time constants (s): lambda_k = 1/tauCap + exp(a_k + da_k)
